# KDL v2 conformance negative controls

The negative half of the official KDL test suite
(<https://github.com/kdl-org/kdl>, `tests/test_cases`, commit
`89c1087d5e7f530de328f18b6a0fad54ca8ea227`). Each `input.kdl` is an
upstream `_fail` case, copyright the KDL contributors, redistributed
unmodified under CC BY-SA 4.0
(<https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/>). The derivation, code
assignment, declared elisions, and warranty notice are in
`../../parse/kdl-spec/PROVENANCE.md`.
